additional_info.subject: RE: ID0396502-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R3 170001597]  Charger offline on OCPP backend. CRM:00641000879
additional_info.body:
Dear Abhinav,
Yesterday I visited the site. As first, I checked the router2 webUI, there was „SIM card not inserted“ status, so I removed the SIM card, clean it with contact spray cleaner and used an electrician tape and made three layers to have the SIM card thicker.
Put it back and in a few minutes it started working.
However, once it started to work I could not see the charger online in the SCB, so I checked also router1 webUI and there was also the “SIM card not inserted” status. So I did the same procedure – contact cleaner spray, electrician tape. But it did not work for several minutes. In meantime I removed and put the SIM card back many times. Reboot teltonika via webUI, reboot teltonika unplugging the power cable. After maybe ten attempts it started to work and recognized the SIM card.
Now it seems online and the connectivity seems to be stable. Fingers crossed.
Please you can close the ticket now.
Thank you for the support
Best Regards
Tomas Cepicka
Siemens, s.r.o.
RC-CZ SI E CS

155 00 Praha 13-Stodůlky
